name: guardian-sign
framing: One small sign alone, seen straight from the front, filling most of the frame, floating in the air: no ground, no shadow, no wall, no people, no text, no border, on a transparent background.
prompt: A small floating hologram sign that the city AI projects in the air to give a passer-by directions: a rounded translucent panel glowing soft cyan, with a thin glowing frame, a simple white arrow pointing to the right and a small bus symbol beside it. No letters, no words.
